verdict.rationale: Kit documents two credential types, OAuth 2.0 for App Store apps and API keys for your own account, plus token revocation and an MCP server that acts on a creator's behalf. None of the evidence mentions permission scopes, read-only keys, or least-privilege restrictions for those credentials. Issuing credentials is adjacent to this story, but scoping them is the capability asked for, and it is not evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
